feature: A drawing shows what was asked, pose and all (third pass)
summary: A painted drawing keeps its small details when it becomes layers: an eye on a dark stripe, a pink mouth, a cream belly. A soft shadow under it and a square behind it are gone. Ask also no longer throws a scene away because a three-word name could not say what the figure was doing.
setup: Photonz Probe, release Next, no switch changed from its default, with the picture model set up in Settings > Ask. Walk: Scripts/playtest/ask-draws-a-scene-walk.json.

try.do: Open a blank picture, press Ask, type "draw a cat playing a guitar" and send it.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Look at the cat's eyes and open mouth: they are their own colours, not merged into the fur or the outline.
Ask for "draw a bird on a branch singing", then "draw a child flying a kite".
Ask for a big drawing in one colour, like "draw a grey rabbit curled up asleep": no square behind it.
Compare each painting with its layers before and after (columns: the painting, the old layers, the new layers).
Compare the six scenes before (2026-10-23-scene-before-sheet.png) and after this pass.

evaluate: Do the eyes, mouths and bellies now look like the painting they came from?
With a drawing on a dark canvas, does anything pale show around its edge or under its feet?
Does the child flying a kite read as a whole child holding the string?
Is about 40 seconds for a drawing request still acceptable?
rough: The six scenes all reached 7 or more on both didWhatWasAsked and designed in one run (20261023-055503-ask, total 90.2). The two runs before missed on one or two cases each (a ball hanging from a dog's mouth, a child painted only to the waist), so this is not every run: the misses come from how the picture model paints.

The held-out total did not rise: 58.0 (20261023-061502-ask-held-out) against 58.1 and 59.5 on the two runs before it and 61 at best; drawings group 65.7 against 66.7, 67.4 and 69.1. This task stays open on that item (a-scene-of-things-doing-something-together-is-dr).
The held-out redline group fell from 31 to 38 to 5.5 and 13.2 over the last two runs with no redline change; logged on ask-s-redlines-do-at-least-as-well-on-unseen-req.
Most of today's run-to-run swing in the held-out total comes from the redline and layout groups, which this task does not touch.
A pale grey part of a drawing that touches the white backdrop with no outline would now be taken for a shadow and dropped. None of the 29 climb paintings I re-traced had one.
No mock covers this surface: it is Ask's existing row and the canvas.
